Northlamp Corporation — Q3 FY2025 earnings release
All EPS figures are USD per diluted share, for the three months ended September 30.
Measure | FY2025 Q3 | FY2024 Q3
Company-adjusted diluted EPS | 1.80 | 1.20
GAAP diluted EPS | 1.50 | 1.10 [1]
